complaint.choose_location: Please choose where the problem is.
complaint.consent_speech: I agree that my voice recording is turned into text for this complaint. The recording is not kept.
complaint.emergency: If this is an emergency, call the guard or the emergency number now. Do not wait for a complaint.
complaint.limit_60s: You can record up to 60 seconds.
fallback.budget_exhausted: AI help has reached today's limit for your society. Everything else works as usual.
fallback.kill_switch: AI help has been switched off for your society. Everything else works as usual.
fallback.not_enabled: AI help is not turned on for your society.
fallback.ordinary_path: AI help is not available right now. You can use the normal form as usual.
feature.bill_anomaly: Check a bill run for unusual amounts
feature.complaint: Describe a problem by voice or text
feature.notification_health: Fix missed alerts on this phone
label.correction: Edit or correct before you confirm
label.declining: You can decline AI help at any time. It never changes how quickly your request is handled.
label.human_review: A person must review this before it is used
label.simulation: Simulated output: this is a test mode, not a real AI model.
notice.needs_approval: This is a draft. A committee member must approve it before it is published.
notice.threat_flag: This wording may sound like a threat: {reason}
notification_health.disclaimer: These steps can reduce missed alerts. They cannot guarantee delivery; the guard may still call you.
promise.no_ads: There are no advertisements and no AI upsell, ever.
promise.no_gate: AI never decides who enters the gate.
promise.no_money: AI never moves money, approves payments or casts votes.
promise.no_training: Your society's data is not used to train AI models.
proposal.expired: This draft has expired. Please create a new one.
proposal.stale: Something changed since this draft was made. Please create a new draft.
translation.legal_review: This text has legal or safety content. A person must approve the translation.
translation.original_shown: The original text is shown next to the translation.
